greeting: Frost Warden Glacius on comms. Stage 3: Spire of Frozen Eternity. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running The Frozen Path. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I met my future self and we argued about shoe durability.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Climb the Spire of Frozen Eternity.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Climb the Spire of Frozen Eternity; Survive the Wardens' trials; Prove worthy of Endurance. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Climb the ancient ice tower and face the Frost Wardens. Immediate move: Climb the Spire of Frozen Eternity.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 3 resolved: Spire of Frozen Eternity. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Warmth Within.
rumor: Villagers report hearing a lullaby inside frozen walls.
People keep repeating one clue from Spire of Frozen Eternity: 'Prove worthy of Endurance'.
Yesterday a corridor tried to charge me toll in riddles. I paid in sarcasm.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn gives hard snow and readable tracks. Best time to cross open ground.
dialog.time_noon: Noon glare can blind you faster than a storm. Shade your optics.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk fog rises from cracked ice. Ropes out, spacing tight.
dialog.time_night: Night cold punishes hesitation. Rotate watch and check each other for frostbite.

party_reactions.kade: Frost Warden Glacius sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Frost Warden Glacius accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Frost Warden Glacius talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: State your objective in one sentence.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Welcome back. What changed since last pass?
relationship_dialog.friend: Good. We move cleaner when we move together.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: No masks, no theater, just us and the objective.
